title: It's very worth it, take this tour
text: We took this tour for our wedding anniversary.Since we were received at our cruise terminal, everything was easy. The car we went in, very spacious and comfortable, with its water bottles for us too. We loved the treatment of the Catalan guide Maria Carmen, she has a lot of knowledge of the city and the food. The cathedral, which is not the sacred family is even more spectacular for its wonderful interior. The mountains we saw with lots of nature and amazing views. Take this tour as you will not be able to see the amusement park otherwise, it is very far away.
author: albertofK8888WZ

title: The best food we ever eat!
text: First of all we want to thank this company for this wonderful idea. We've been to Barcelona 4 times cruising the ocean.  This is a very different tour, very relaxed, plenty of natural places, in the city! We didn't expect to find so many natural parks!We spent the best 4 hoursin Barcelona with Maria. We went to the 2 most important hills, the rooftop of the Catedral with the elevator and the cable car in the jewish hill. About the food...Everything was very authentic... so many flavours...This was a must!
author: F4932ZFpedroa
